summary: AIR Global PLC, a Dubai-domiciled FSM (flavored shisha molasses) maker listed on Nasdaq, furnished a 6-K with Q3 and nine-month 2026 results, a results presentation, and a shareholder letter. Q3 revenue rose 11.1% year over year to $99.8 million and Adjusted EBITDA 7.7% to $30.9 million; nine-month revenue was $306.7 million, up 6.0%. Management reiterated 2026 revenue growth guidance of 4%-6%. Separately disclosed: $425 million of 7.875% senior unsecured notes due 2031 issued October 1, 2026, plus a new $0.28 annual dividend and up to $100 million buyback.
